title: Shields
html:
There are 3 sizes of shield in the game:

  • small, round shiels which take up 4 spaces in the inventory
    • Spiked Doily
    • Padded Buckler
    • Scale Shield
  • medium shields which take up 6 spaces in the inventory
    • Ghost Buckler
    • Crystal Shield
    • Plate Shield
  • large, tower shields which take up 8 spaces in the inventory.

There are different types of shield in each category, and the %block chance for shield is generally inline with it's size - but not always so.

A shield takes the place of a second melee weapon and can't be used with a two-handed weapon or a ranged weapon.
